_help: Add your own callout types here. Use them in notes as  > [!theorem] Title  (add - or + after ] to make it foldable). color is r,g,b. icon is one of: pencil clipboard info checkCircle flame check help alert x zap bug list quote star lightbulb book target pin heart shield sigma flask - or give your own icon as  "paths": ["M..", ".."]  (24x24 stroke path data). "aliases" are extra names for the same type. Delete this file's entries any time; it is optional.
